findings.detail: §11 'Verified starting status and reporting' has missing ASCII spaces that run identifiers into adjacent words: 'run39985646229', 'is2.6.3', 'constitution1.0.2', 'STYNX1.5.3', 'at9b2a190a…', 'at0e26c795:36/43', 'to36'. The meaning is still clear, but a search for the exact run ID, SHA or version token is harder to anchor. The following text 'CI run\n39985646190' wraps correctly and is not affected. Insert the missing spaces.

The same missing-space defect appears in 'on2026-10-23', 'the40JNY/', '110UC/12overlappingJW', 'all64RAIT' and 'main80505ac0'. Insert the spaces ('40 JNY', '110 UC', '12 overlapping JW', '64 RAIT', 'main 80505ac0') so they match the §11 wording and the identifiers can be searched.

Validation notes repeat the missing-space pattern: 'main80505ac0…', 'sections3,4,9', '(773 artifacts,446 canonical tokens)', '(61 ADRs,6 redirects,45 rounds,25 closures)', 'exit4'. This is cosmetic and does not affect correctness. Fix it before the PR if this file is committed as evidence.

scope: Read-only Architect review of git diff against HEAD 80505ac0 (BUILD-PLAN.md, COMPLETION-PLAN.md, DESIGN-DECISIONS.md, docs/meta/adr/README.md, backlog.md, rait-progress-plan-2026-10-23.md, orchestration-handoff.md, C-0004 campaign) plus the untracked ADR-0060 and work/planning/2026-10-23-consolidated-roadmap/. Checked: COMPLETION-PLAN §3, §4 and §9 are byte-identical to HEAD. §5 was only retitled 'Historical' and has an additive pointer to §11. The original header and status are kept under a dated historical heading. No changes under law/, .devai/, record/, ADR-0042 or ADR-0057. ADR-0060 says it supplements ADR-0042, and the index rows are added in both docs/meta/adr/README.md and DESIGN-DECISIONS.md, consistent with how ADR-0059 is listed. Each banner keeps #211 unmerged, S3 runtime held and C6 blocked. §11 states no automatic merge and no upstream writes, releases, legal facts or native/field/deployment authority. M1 keeps official migration, exact-SHA measurement, role separation, runtime guards and unchanged thresholds and N/A cells. R-0036…R-0039 are not reopened and R-0041…R-0045 are stated as open. DEVAI 2.6.3 installed and 2.7.0 released-but-not-adopted are stated correctly, and the CI-pass/trusted-RC-fail split is recorded. Transient review.json.raw.* and review.json.formatted.* bridge files were present and are not judged as delivery content. No RC or test suites were run.
